All SEVEN files upstream publishes are vendored, not a selection. An earlier
revision of this record took four of them and described that as the whole set;
it was not, and a partial corpus described as complete is worse than a partial
one described honestly.

FOUR of the seven carry SAF's scalar count bound (`total: 19`), the shape this
tool rejected until hdf-libs-az40y: the four triple_overlay_* files. The
`.bad.*` names describe the verdict SAF expects against ITS source document,
not a malformed spec — all seven are well-formed SAF thresholds.

These are threshold SPECS, not HDF documents, so no HDF schema applies and none
was validated against. What vouches for them is that they are SAF's own test
inputs at a pinned commit: `saf validate threshold` runs against these exact
bytes upstream. CLAUDE.md's schema-confirmed fallback does not apply because SAF
publishes no schema for this format; the real-source case is satisfied outright.

Consumers: hdf-engine/go/threshold_saf_test.go and hdf-engine/test/threshold-saf.test.ts.
Kept here rather than in hdf-fixtures because that corpus is HDF documents and
these are not.
